resources.string: Needed so you can remotely lock or erase this phone if it is lost or stolen.

While this phone is locked, closes the power menu and the Quick Settings panel (which has its own power button and airplane mode), so someone who has taken it cannot simply switch it off or cut it off the network. It only looks at the system\'s own lock-screen panels (com.android.systemui), never at other apps, and sends nothing it reads anywhere.
